display.purpose: Hero headline only (.display-hero); weight-300 whisper, balance-wrapped.

headline.purpose: Section titles (.section-title); stands alone, no eyebrow above it.

title.purpose: Row and card titles (.row__title) at Inter variable weight 510.

body.purpose: Base prose; .lead (17px) and .lead-lg carry section intros in secondary color, capped 46-62ch.

label.purpose: The organizing voice: uppercase Geist Mono +0.08em for nav links, row tags, stat captions, console titlebars, field labels.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: The system is flat and shadowless; separation comes from surface steps and 1px hairlines.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: A 1px ring-border masquerading as elevation (dark Iron; #e5e2d8 in light). Not a real shadow.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible ring — the only true box-shadow in the system (0.5 alpha in light theme).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default 150ms easing for hover/state transitions (buttons, links, borders).

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: .rise, 0.7s translateY(14px)+fade, staggered via --rise-delay (90ms steps) in the hero only.

motion.name: spectro-breathe
motion.purpose: The hero spectrogram's ambient breathe; staggered on 3n/7n cycles; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ember Button
components.description: The primary CTA pill: Ember fill, near-black Void label, 12px uppercase mono-feel tracking.
components.css: .ds-btn-ember { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #e96b34); color: #0e0e13; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 570; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-ember:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #f07d4a); } .ds-btn-ember:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Mint Button
components.description: The secondary CTA pill: hard-coded Mint Pulse fill in both themes, Void label. Never a third sibling beside the pair.
components.css: .ds-btn-mint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #62f6b5; color: #0e0e13; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 570; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-mint:hover { background: #79f8c0; } .ds-btn-mint:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Console Pill
components.description: The inverted TALK TO VERA pill: text-primary background, page-background text, uppercase mono, 2x2 dotgrid.
components.css: .ds-console-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 17px 38px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); color: var(--bg, #0e0e13); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-console-pill:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-console-pill:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-dotgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 4px); gap: 3px; } .ds-dotgrid i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 1px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Mono Link
components.description: The quiet tertiary action: uppercase mono text link with a small arrow; used wherever a third CTA is tempting.
components.html: See the platform
components.css: .ds-link-mono { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-link-mono:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); } .ds-link-mono svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

components.name: Console Panel
components.description: The Carbon surface with a mono titlebar and status dot — the site's card and its code-drawn 'image' frame.
components.html:
vera.studio — deep agentlive
Console body content sits on 20px padding inside the 5.6px Carbon frame.
components.css: .ds-console { background: var(--surface, #09090b); border: 1px solid var(--border, #27272a); border-radius: 5.6px; overflow: hidden; max-width: 520px; } .ds-console-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #27272a); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-tertiary, #71717a); } .ds-console-spacer { margin-left: auto; } .ds-console-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #62f6b5); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-console-body { padding: 20px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: 5.6px console tag on a hairline; mono variant for tool/status tags inside consoles.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 5.6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #27272a); background: var(--surface, #09090b); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: The hairline-skeleton content row: mono tag, title plus body, right-aligned mono metric; tag turns Ember on hover.
components.html: voiceCalls that hold upSub-second replies on live audio. Callers can interrupt mid-sentence and still get the right answer.<1.2s voice-to-voice
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 176px 1fr auto; gap: 16px 28px; align-items: baseline; padding: 22px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #27272a); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #27272a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-row-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-tertiary, #71717a); transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-row-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 510; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); } .ds-row-body { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); margin-top: 6px; max-width: 62ch; } .ds-row-metric { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary, #fffaea) 3%, transparent); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-tag { color: var(--accent, #e96b34); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Contact-form input: 5.6px, hairline stroke, mono label above; focus turns the border Ember with no ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-f">Work email</label><input id="ds-f" class="ds-field" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" />
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; max-width: 320px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--surface, #09090b); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3f3f46); border-radius: 5.6px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary, #71717a); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #e96b34); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); }

components.name: Nav Link Row
components.description: The console nav voice: wide-tracked uppercase mono links, secondary to primary on hover/current.
components.html: VeyraPlatformSolutionsPricing
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 0 4px; height: 60px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(216, 215, 212, 0.22); } .ds-nav-word { font-weight: 650; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-secondary, #a1a1aa); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-primary, #fffaea); }

components.name: Spectro Waveform
components.description: The signature: the only place the six-hue palette appears — full-bleed hero voice spectrogram with a reduced-motion-aware breathe.
components.css: .ds-spectro { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; width: 100%; height: 118px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-spectro i { flex: 1 0 auto; min-width: 5px; border-radius: 5.6px; height: 16%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n+1) { background: #4dcafa; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n+2) { background: #de94e2; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n+3) { background: #ffdd03; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n+4) { background: #9977ff; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n+5) { background: #62f6b5; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(6n) { background: #e96b34; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+1) { height: 22%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+2) { height: 48%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+3) { height: 92%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+4) { height: 36%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+5) { height: 74%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+6) { height: 100%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+7) { height: 58%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+8) { height: 28%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+9) { height: 82%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n+10) { height: 44%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(11n) { height: 64%; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(13n) { height: 14%; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-spectro i { animation: ds-spectro-breathe 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: center; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(3n) { animation-delay: 0.5s; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(3n+1) { animation-delay: 1.1s; } .ds-spectro i:nth-child(7n) { animation-duration: 4.2s; } } @keyframes ds-spectro-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.68); } }

narrative.overview: Veyra's marketing site is a voice-AI platform rendered as the console it is. The canvas is near-black Void, panels are Carbon, raised elements are Slab; the structure is drawn entirely in 1px Iron hairlines; the ink is warm Cream, never pure white. Headlines whisper at weight 300 while wide-tracked Geist Mono labels do the organizing. Color is rationed with intent: the six-hue neon spectrogram appears exactly once — as the full-bleed hero waveform — and everywhere else the only chromatic voices are the Ember Orange / Mint Pulse action pair. Dark is the definitive brand rendition; light is the same token system re-expressed on warm paper. The system explicitly refuses the aurora/glass/gradient SaaS hero: it is flat and shadowless throughout. Depth comes from the three near-black surface steps and hairline borders. The site's images are code-drawn product consoles built from the system's own grammar — never stock art or browser chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Void/Carbon/Slab surface ladder with Iron 1px hairline structure; zero box-shadows
Cream ink (#fffaea) at weight-300 display sizes; 12px uppercase +0.08em Geist Mono labels
Ember + Mint full-pill CTA pair with near-black labels — always binary, never a third
Six-color spectrogram quarantined to the hero waveform (.spectro) only
5.6px container radius everywhere; actions are full pills — nothing in between
One authored entrance (hero .rise stagger) plus the spectrogram's breathe; all other sections static
Both themes ship from one token set; light is the warm-paper counterpart, dark is definitive

rules.name: The Quarantine Rule
rules.body: The six-color spectrogram palette appears in .spectro and nowhere else. Any other graphic that needs a waveform uses .gwave — single-color Ember bars.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Outside the hero waveform, the only accents on any screen are Ember and Mint. Semantic colors speak only inside console mocks' log lines and status dots.

rules.name: The Standing Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. No eyebrows, no kickers, no mono-tag stacked above a section title — the mono voice labels rows, stats, and consoles, never headlines.

rules.name: The Mono Address Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, tags, or navigates is 11-12px uppercase Geist Mono at +0.08em; anything that persuades is Inter. The two voices never blend mid-element.

rules.name: The Hairline Skeleton Rule
rules.body: Sections, rows, plan features, and footer are all separated by the same 1px --border hairline. Never introduce a divider of any other weight, color, or style.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, ever — not on hover, not on overlay. If an element needs separation, give it the next surface step and a hairline.

rules.name: The Two-Silhouette Rule
rules.body: If it holds content it's a 5.6px rectangle; if you click it to act it's a full pill.

dos: Do build every action as one of exactly two pills: Ember primary + Mint secondary, 12px uppercase +0.08em labels in near-black (#0e0e13) — and demote any third action to a .link-mono text link.
Do give every container the 5.6px radius and a 1px hairline; step to the next surface token (Carbon to Slab / Paper to Parchment) when something must feel raised.
Do open every below-the-fold section with .band--line and let .section-title stand alone at weight 300.
Do label with 11-12px uppercase Geist Mono at +0.08em (row tags, stat captions, console bars, field labels) and keep prose in Inter.
Do draw new product imagery as .console mocks in the system's own grammar — mono titlebar, status dot, hairline internals.
Do style both themes through the tokens; dark (Void/Carbon/Iron/Cream) is the definitive rendition, light is its warm-paper counterpart from the same variables.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the .rise entrance, spectro breathe, and console-pill scale all switch off.
donts: Don't use the six-color spectrogram palette outside .spectro; in-console waveforms are single-color Ember .gwave bars.
Don't add box-shadows, glows, gradients, or glass effects anywhere — --shadow-card is none by design; the nav's backdrop-blur is the only translucency.
Don't place an eyebrow, kicker, or mono-tag above a headline; headlines stand alone.
Don't introduce a third CTA sibling, a non-pill button, or an 8px friendly card radius — the system has exactly two silhouettes.
Don't push display or section headings above weight 300, or brighten dark-theme text past Cream (#fffaea) to pure white.
Don't add entrance animations beyond the hero's .rise stagger; sections below the fold arrive static.
Don't reach into the DESK INBOX or Studio class layers from site pages, or use .site-*/marketing classes inside the apps — the systems share tokens, not components.
Don't invent customer logos, testimonials, or new metrics; the proof strip is the real infrastructure stack and the published numbers (PRODUCT.md).
